13: theorem positiveTraceReader_not_cyclic (P : SiteProfile) :
14:     ¬ ∀ x y : (regularCoreAlgebra P).toStarSubalgebra,
15:       positiveTraceReader P (x*y) = positiveTraceReader P (y*x) := by
16:   obtain ⟨e,v,he,hene,hv,hev⟩ := regularCore_matrix_corner P
17:   have hes := he.isSelfAdjoint.star_eq
18:   have hee : e.val*e.val=e.val := he.isIdempotentElem
19:   have hvne : v.val ≠ 0 := by
20:     intro hz
21:     apply hene
22:     apply Subtype.ext
23:     change e.val = 0
24:     simpa only [hz,star_zero,zero_mul] using hv.symm
25:   have hve : v.val*e.val=v.val := by
26:     have hh : star (v.val-v.val*e.val)*(v.val-v.val*e.val)=0 := by
27:       calc
28:         _ = star v.val*v.val - (star v.val*v.val)*e.val -
29:             e.val*(star v.val*v.val) + e.val*(star v.val*v.val)*e.val := by
30:               rw [star_sub,star_mul,hes]
31:               noncomm_ring
32:         _ = 0 := by rw [hv,hee]; noncomm_ring [hee]
33:     exact (sub_eq_zero.mp ((CStarRing.star_mul_self_eq_zero_iff _).mp hh)).symm
34:   have hvse : star v.val*e.val=0 := by
35:     simpa only [star_mul,hes,star_zero] using congrArg star hev
36:   have hesv : e.val*star v.val=star v.val := by
37:     simpa only [star_mul,hes] using congrArg star hve
38:   have hbad : ¬ 0 ≤ e.val+star v.val := by
39:     intro hp
40:     have hs := hp.isSelfAdjoint.star_eq
41:     rw [star_add,hes,star_star] at hs
42:     have hvs : v.val=star v.val := add_left_cancel hs
43:     apply hvne
44:     calc
45:       _ = e.val*v.val := by rw [hvs,hesv]
46:       _ = 0 := hev
